parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4818987. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls if structures are missing. Return the specified columns and sort by molecule_chembl_id.
